name: Arabic101 Assistant
changelog: Dual Companion Modes: Compact toolbar popup and resizable Standalone Desktop Window with full sidebar navigation and Light/Dark theme switcher.
Full-Page Desktop Layout: Sticky top header bar, floating Back-to-Top button, and automatic route persistence across reloads.
Inline Class Details & Attachments: Expand lesson summaries, homework, notes, and teacher/student image & PDF attachments directly inside class cards and lesson history.
Interactive My Plan Comparison: View 1-on-1 vs. Group class formats and click any Academy plan card (Premium, Pro, Standard, Halaqah) for a 50:50 side-by-side perk comparison.
Teacher Workflow Tools: End-of-class report modal with image & PDF uploads (plus auto-draft recovery), yesterday unclosed session alerts, and weekly availability management.
Proactive Desktop & Audio Alerts: Class countdown reminders, classroom waiting alerts, schedule change notices, and multi-tab leader-elected chat notifications.
